name: Worldwide Rush Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11 64 Bit
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 capable GPU with 1 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11 64 Bit
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 capable GPU with 3 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: Worldwide Rush lets you experience passenger transportation and management on a global scale. Expand your company, meet the growing travel demand, compete against other companies, and discover new continents with its unique vehicles. The entire world is yours to control.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Lithuanian, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian
